content: पार्वत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) [पर्वते भवः अण्] .²1 Being or living on a mountain. .²2 Growing on or coming from a mountain. .²3 Mountainous; प्रतिश्रयार्थं सेवेत पार्वतीं वा पुनर्गुहाम् <ls>Mb. 14. 46. 26</ls>.

पार्वती [पर्वतस्यापत्यं स्त्री अण्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā, born as the daughter of the Himālaya mountain (she was Satī in her former birth; cf <ls>Ku. 1. 21</ls>); तां पार्वतीत्याभिजनेन नाम्ना बन्धुप्रियां बन्धुजनो जुहाव <ls>Ku. 1. 26</ls>. .²2 A female cowherd. .²3 An epithet of Draupadī. .²4 A mountain stream. .²5 A kind of fragrant earth.
